descriptionChirho: The act of unlawfully taking human life, murder or slaughter. All grammatical forms (singular N-AMS/N-GMS/N-DMS and plural N-NMP/N-GMP) express the same concept with no semantic differentiation: spa 'homicidio/muerte/asesinatos', hin 'hatya/vadh' (murder/killing), arb 'qatl' (killing/murder, consistent across all forms), kor 'salin' (murder, uniform across cases), swa 'mauaji/kuuawa' (murder/killing/being killed). The dative form S78697 (eng 'murder', swa 'kuuawa') simply marks a different syntactic role, not a different meaning.
